activity.notes: William Waldegrave, 1st Baron Radstock, received his Newfoundland governorship appointment on 16 May 1797 and served through 1800. The reviewed sources do not support an exact final calendar day, so the end is recorded only to the year with approximate boundary certainty.

sources.title: WALDEGRAVE, WILLIAM, 1st Baron Radstock — Dictionary of Canadian Biography
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography identifies William Waldegrave, 1st Baron Radstock, as governor of Newfoundland, appointed in 1797 and serving until 1800.

sources.title: History of Government House — Government of Newfoundland and Labrador
sources.citation_text: Newfoundland and Labrador's Government House history lists William Waldegrave among the governors of Newfoundland in the 1797–1800 period.
